# KitchenManifest

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Model` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public record KitchenManifest : ISchemaVersioned
```

A Kitchen: the top-level workspace, and the sixth domain word. It is the folder loose Recipes and Ingredients are saved into, given a name — the creation-flows spec settled that the "loose items folder" and the "workspace" are one concept rather than two.

## Remarks

This manifest deliberately does NOT list what the Kitchen contains. Membership is whatever sits in the folder beside the .ktn, discovered on open — see `Formats.Kitchen`. A recorded list would go stale the moment a file was renamed or moved outside the app, and the Kitchen would then be describing a workspace that no longer exists.
